description: Agent Mining Records: submit mine inspection records, the regulator’s inspection record itself, with the schedule, citations, abatements and the mine record’s areas and workings they answer to: the reading moment; each area or working the mine record identifies with its id, reference and name; each inspection the record’s own schedule requires with its id, reference, the area and the moments its window opens and it is due; each inspection entry with its id, reference, the area or working inspected, the inspector and the moment inspected; each citation with its id, reference, the inspection entry, the moment issued and the moment abatement is due; each abatement entry with its id, reference, the citation and the moment abated. The signed report gives the inspections and the records behind them, each scheduled inspection due against an inspection entry of its area in its window, each citation past its abatement date against an abatement entry, each inspection entry against the areas and workings the mine record identifies, and each citation against the inspection entry it was issued under, and counts them, and names divergent mine inspection records: an inspection the schedule requires with no entry behind it, a citation past its abatement date with no abatement entry, an inspection entry for an area or working the mine record does not identify, and a citation with no inspection entry behind it; then an abatement dated before its citation was issued and an abatement naming a citation the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No inspection entries, or no areas beside inspected areas, leaves those points unverified. Areas, inspections, citations and entries match by letters and digits, dates by the day, a schedule entry naming no area is met by an inspection of any area, and an inspection or abatement due after the reading moment waits. This reads the inspection record kept on a mine, from the schedule to each citation’s abatement. Verdict mine_inspection_record_divergent, mine_inspection_record_partial, mine_inspection_record_unverified or mine_inspection_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-inspection-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.
